<!-- pr-reviewer: b2b717162b429091d4d35108f08c863f2ad7a32d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** - valid after #3353 merges and this branch takes `origin/main`.

Delta review at `b2b717162` of the rework since the last review at `addb167c2`. Scope: the maintainer's RINGS_FALLBACK WARN decision (#3035) and the merge of main. #3353 is the parent of the pass-start family and merges first, so the whole family is not re-reviewed here.

## What looks good

- The rework routes every forced-order fallback note through `RINGS_FALLBACK` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm_start.rs:65`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket_hsm.rs:80-84`). The note contains `" - Offset rings cut "` and ends with `" instead"`, so `rings_fallbacks()` counts it (`pocket_hsm.rs:99-101`).
- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3751-3756` raises `Warning::StrategyFallback { at, areas }` from that count. An Outside or Inside fallback to rings now warns, and does not pass silent.
- Auto is unchanged. The `start == PassStart::Auto` arm keeps main's note text, and `adaptive_passes` still calls `adaptive_ordered(..., PassStart::Auto)`.
- The fig8 pins assert exactly one `StrategyFallback` warning and no other (`crates/app/tests/adaptive_pass_start.rs:138-139` and `:157-158`). This is the pin the last review asked for.
- The Trochoidal refusal is unchanged and still pinned at the command door and in the generator (`crates/app/tests/adaptive_pass_start.rs:172-190`).
- `crates/app/tests/stock_play_cost_bench.rs:91` adds `pass_start: Default::default()`. Clippy `--all-targets` now compiles this file.
- The body keeps its `Changelog:` line and ends `Fixes #3355`.
- The trial merge with `origin/main` (`64b7377297`) is clean.

## Results (local, trial-merged with `origin/main` 64b7377297)

| Binary / suite | Result |
|---|---|
| motion lib `machining2d::` | 261 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored |
| app `adaptive_pass_start` | 4 passed |
| app `offset_pass_start` | 3 passed |
| app `example_catalog_adaptive` | 1 passed |
| app `stock_play_cost_bench` | 3 ignored (benchmarks); builds |
| ui lib `pass_start` | 2 passed |
| clippy motion/app/ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

## Heavy lanes

Not run - owed to the cut (#3558: a `P2` gets no heavy lane). The light lane was not run.

## Law checks

- The rework's non-test code has no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!`.
- The switch is named in the toolpath notes, and the warning reaches the toolpath. No refusal or safety rule is lost.
- The delta adds no dependency, edits no process file and does not edit `PROCESS_VERSION`.
- No snapshot PNG and no golden moved.

## Notes (not blocking)

- `docs/decisions/3355-adaptive-pass-start.md` does not record the WARN choice. The commit message does. One sentence in "What was decided" would keep the decision file complete.
- The screenshot ask from the last review belongs to the #3353 UI row. Check it on the parent before the merge.
- The `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` line in the whole PR diff comes from #3353. It leaves this diff when the parent merges.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ddeda1259bb1b67b36ddc5e4076cf5954cf6a27a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is the delta review of `b2b717162..ddeda1259`: the merge of main `e313aa663` with the adaptive feature re-expressed on main's `StartSide`, then the merge of main `fdda55e15`.

What looks good
- Main's `StartSide { start, stock, around_part }` wins. `pocket_started_in` is gone for `pocket_started_on`. The Adaptive arm calls `pocket_hsm_start::adaptive_passes_from`. Every other arm and every Adaptive ring fallback go to `level_rings::ring_plan`, with its completeness guard and the `RINGS_FALLBACK` warning. The #3316 law is intact.
- Both features survive: #3316 Offset (its arms are unchanged) and #3355 Adaptive (Auto / Inside / Outside, the Trochoidal refusal at the command door, in the generator and on the row).
- Auto is byte-for-byte. The Auto arm passes `region = None`, `stock = None`, `start = Auto`, so it is the old `adaptive_passes` plan. The `inside_without_holes_is_the_growth_plan_and_auto_ignores_the_stock` pin compares Auto with and without the stock outline.
- One stock source. `generate.rs` builds `StartSide.stock` from `pass_start_stock::footprint` only, and only off Auto. There is no second footprint API.
- No refusal or warning is lost. The Outside and Inside switch uses one note that contains `RINGS_FALLBACK` and ends `instead`, so it raises the #3035 StrategyFallback warning. The app pins assert exactly one such warning.
- UI test union. The second merge keeps both tests. The Adaptive row test now asserts the Trochoidal refusal line, and the `#[test]` count does not change.

Results (locally, in a worktree trial-merged with `origin/main` `fdda55e15`; the merge reported "Already up to date")
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib pass_start`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib pocket_hsm_start`: 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test adaptive_pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test offset_pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored (heavy lane, #3316 fig8 Outside).
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib pass_start`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
There is no failure text.

Heavy lanes: not run in this review - owed to the cut (#3558). The heavy list in the PR body (`motion heavy: adaptive_hsm`, `app heavy: adaptive_pass_start`, `app heavy: offset_pass_start` and the others) was read before this delta resolution. It does not cover the re-expressed code. The release lanes must be green on the final head before the cut.

Retargeted pin: accepted. `fig8_inside_adaptive_starts_on_the_part_wall_and_cuts_out_to_the_edge` still pins the intended law. The first pass stands on the part wall (R8). The band reaches the stock edge on both sides, and each side has at least one edge feed. It drops the old "last vertex is the stock edge" assert. That assert was an artifact of a one-piece area. Main's #3316 ring law cuts each connected piece on its own, so the last vertex is one piece's last cut. The retarget keeps the law and stops pinning a coincidence. It is not a weakened law.

Requested before merge
None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The retargeted pin asserts an edge cut on each side, not a count. The whole-edge completeness rests on `ring_plan`'s guard. A count pin would be stronger, but the guard covers it.
- `mill2d_page.rs` is 411 lines and `generate.rs` is 4344. Both were over 400 before this PR; the delta adds 2 and about 18 lines. Flagged for growth only, per the law.
- The PR is still a draft. The merging session flags it ready immediately before the merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
